_help: Copy this file to scripts/espn_config.json (that file is never uploaded to GitHub) and fill it in.
Add one entry to "leagues" per ESPN league. league_id and team_id are in your team page URL: ...?leagueId=XXXX&teamId=Y
label is optional: a short name for the league switcher (otherwise the ESPN league name is used).
Public leagues: leave espn_s2 and swid empty. Private leagues: one pair of cookies works for all your leagues.
To find them in Edge or Chrome: on fantasy.espn.com (logged in), click the lock icon left of the address,
then Cookies (Cookies in use) > espn.com > Cookies, and copy the Content of espn_s2 and SWID (keep the curly braces).
Treat these like a password: don't paste them into chats, screenshots or GitHub.
